title: Cellular visualization of G-quadruplex RNA via fluorescence lifetime imaging microscopy
authors: Robinson J; Stenspil SG; Maleckaite K; Bartlett M; Di Antonio M; Vilar R; Kuimova MK
one_liner_zh: 该文开发荧光寿命成像探针用于细胞内G-四链体RNA可视化，属核酸结构成像方法，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作、结合位点预测或AI/物理模拟建模，与本课题无关。
abstract:
ABSTRACT

Over the last decade, appreciation of the roles of G-quadruplex (G4) structures in cellular regulation and maintenance have rapidly grown, making the establishment of robust methods to visualize G4s increasingly important. Fluorescent probes are commonly used for G4 detection in vitro , however, achieving sufficient selectivity to detect G4s in a dense and structurally diverse cellular environment is challenging. The use of fluorescence probes for G4 detection is further complicated by variations of probe uptake into cells, which may affect fluorescence intensity independently of G4 abundance. In this work, we report an alternative small-molecule approach to visualize G4s that does not rely on fluorescence intensity switch-on and thus, does not require the use of molecules with exclusive G4 binding selectivity. Specifically, we have developed a novel thiazole orange derivative, TOR-G4, that exhibits a unique fluorescence lifetime when bound to G4s compared to other structures, allowing G4 binding to be sensitively distinguished from non-G4 binding, independently of local probe concentration. Furthermore, TOR-G4 primarily co-localizes with RNA in the cytoplasm and nucleoli of cells, making it the first lifetime-based probe validated for exploring the emerging roles of RNA G4s in cellulo .

abstract_zh:
摘要

在过去十年中，对G-四链体（G4）结构在细胞调控和维持中作用的认识迅速增长，使得建立稳健的G4可视化方法日益重要。荧光探针常用于体外G4检测，然而，在致密且结构多样的细胞环境中实现足够的选择性以检测G4具有挑战性。使用荧光探针进行G4检测还因探针进入细胞的摄取差异而进一步复杂化，这可能独立于G4丰度而影响荧光强度。在本工作中，我们报告了一种替代性的小分子方法来可视化G4，该方法不依赖于荧光强度开启，因此不需要使用具有专属G4结合选择性的分子。具体而言，我们开发了一种新型噻唑橙衍生物TOR-G4，当结合G4时，与其他结构相比，其表现出独特的荧光寿命，从而能够灵敏地区分G4结合与非G4结合，且独立于局部探针浓度。此外，TOR-G4主要与细胞质和核仁中的RNA共定位，使其成为首个经过验证的基于寿命的探针，用于探索RNA G4在细胞内的新兴作用。
